description: Migration creates tenant-scoped table ticket_bundle_status_propagations (propagation_id, master_ticket_id, child_ticket_id, action, child_previous_status_id, propagated_by, propagated_at, reverted_at, reverted_by) with FKs to tickets ON DELETE CASCADE
Migration adds partial unique index on (tenant, child_ticket_id) WHERE reverted_at IS NULL and an index on (tenant, master_ticket_id)
ticket_bundle_status_propagations registered in server/migrations/utils/tenantDb.cjs as a tenant-scoped table

previewBundleStatusPropagation(trx, tenant, masterTicketId, newStatusId) in ticketBundleUtils.ts returns crossesBoundary null when ticket is not a sync_updates master or the status change does not cross open/closed
Preview for a close lists currently-open children as affected and already-closed children as unaffected (reason already_closed)

Preview for a reopen lists closed children with an active propagation row from this master as affected; closed children without one as unaffected (reason independently_closed); open children as already_open
Preview child query is a single tenant-scoped query joining statuses (is_closed) and left-joining active propagation rows
BundlePropagationConfirmationRequiredError class in packages/tickets carries the preview payload (crossesBoundary, affectedChildren, unaffectedChildren)
Child propagation block extracted from updateTicketInTransaction into propagateBundleMasterStatus(trx, ctx, masterId, updateData, options) in ticketBundleUtils.ts
updateTicketInTransaction / updateTicketWithCache / updateTicket accept options.propagateToChildren?: boolean
Write path throws BundlePropagationConfirmationRequiredError (no rows written) when preview crosses the boundary with ≥1 affected child and propagateToChildren is undefined
propagateToChildren: false performs the master write only — no child rows updated, no child live-update events
propagateToChildren: true on a close updates only the affected (open) children, leaving already-closed children's status/closed_at/closed_by untouched
propagateToChildren: true on a reopen updates only children with an active propagation row from this master
Boundary-neutral master updates (open→open, closed→closed, assignee/priority only) keep existing sync behaviour and ignore the flag
Propagated child UPDATE includes is_closed together with status_id, closed_at, closed_by (and assigned_to/priority_id when present)
Propagated close inserts one ticket_bundle_status_propagations row per affected child with child_previous_status_id and propagated_by
Propagated reopen sets reverted_at/reverted_by on the affected children's active rows
removeChildFromBundleAction and unbundleMasterTicketAction (and the TicketService equivalents) revert the child's active propagation row
Affected children are re-derived inside the write transaction; the client's preview list is never trusted for the UPDATE
Master bundle activity row BUNDLE_STATUS_PROPAGATED written on propagated close/reopen (details: action, child_ticket_ids) and with propagated:false on master-only boundary changes
TicketService.update and TicketService.updateStatus call propagateBundleMasterStatus so the REST path propagates in sync mode with the same flag semantics
updateTicketSchema and updateTicketStatusSchema accept optional propagateToChildren boolean
handleApiError maps BundlePropagationConfirmationRequiredError to 409 CONFLICT with details.reason = bundle_propagation_confirmation_required and the preview payload
OpenAPI workManagementV1.ts documents propagateToChildren on the ticket update and status bodies and the 409 response; generated registries regenerated
previewBundleStatusPropagationAction(masterTicketId, newStatusId) server action (withAuth, ticket:read) returning the FR1 preview
previewBulkBundleStatusPropagationAction(ticketIds, newStatusId) returns previews keyed by master ticket id, skipping non-masters and boundary-neutral changes
BundleStatusPropagationDialog component (built on ConfirmationDialog) lists affected children by number+title, shows unaffected children for reopen, and offers propagate / master only / cancel
TicketDetails.tsx confirmStatusChange helper runs close rules then propagation preview and resolves {proceed, propagateToChildren}; dropdown handleSelectChange uses it
handleResolveAndClose, resolution-comment close, and handleBatchSaveChanges route through confirmStatusChange and pass the flag to updateTicketWithCache
Cancelling the propagation dialog leaves the status select on the current value with no write
No propagation dialog appears when the preview has zero affected children (write proceeds directly)
bulkUpdateTicketStatus accepts options.propagateToChildren and forwards it per ticket
BulkChangeStatusDialog calls the bulk preview on status selection and shows a summary section with per-master affected-children lists
BulkChangeStatusDialog radio 'Apply to children' (default) / 'Masters only' passes propagateToChildren on confirm; hidden when no master is affected
Mobile updateTicketStatus sends propagateToChildren when provided

Mobile StatusPickerModal handles the 409 bundle_propagation_confirmation_required by presenting affected children with propagate / master only / cancel and resubmitting; the existing close confirmation is merged into this flow

Locale keys bulk.bundle.syncUpdatesHelp, bulk.bundleSyncUpdatesHelp and details.bundle.childrenDescription updated in en/de/es/fr/it/nl to state that closing/reopening the master closes/reopens children
API changelog entry documenting the new field, the 409, and that sync-mode masters now propagate via REST
